text: dsh-fulltext-search 是面向 DSH Web 的侧边栏全文搜索插件。它通过 dsh-better-sidebar 注册搜索标签，并在宿主端提供搜索接口，从当前会话记录的工作目录查找文件内容。用户可以使用普通文本或正则表达式搜索，调整大小写、全字匹配和 include/exclude 范围，并查看文件名、行号及匹配行预览；选择结果可在侧边栏编辑器中打开文件。系统有 ripgrep 时可使用该引擎，否则使用内置 JavaScript 引擎。适合需要在 DSH 会话工作目录中定位代码或文本内容的用户；需要安装 dsh-better-sidebar，不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-fulltext-search adds file-content search to the DSH Web sidebar. It searches the current session folder, shows matching paths and line previews, and opens selected files in the editor. It supports regex and case options, uses ripgrep when available, and requires dsh-better-sidebar.
想在 DSH 侧边栏里搜当前会话目录中的文件内容。
Find a phrase inside files in my current DSH session folder.
DSH 能不能按正则表达式查找项目文件里的匹配行？
dsh-fulltext-search 的功能「会话目录全文搜索」：在侧边栏输入关键词后，可搜索当前会话工作目录下的文件内容，并显示文件、行号和匹配行预览。用户可调整正则、大小写和全字选项，点击匹配结果可在编辑器中打开文件。

dsh-fulltext-search README · dsh-fulltext-search：DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 插件：在侧边栏文件管理（[dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)）中按**文件内容**全文搜索当前会话工作目录，返回 `文件 + 行号 + 匹配行预览`，点击结果即可在编辑器中打开文件。

支持正则表达式、区分大小写、全字精确匹配、智能大小写与 include/exclude 范围过滤。系统装有 [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) 时自动使用（与 VSCode 搜索同款引擎，性能最佳）；未安装则回退内置 JS 引擎，功能一致。

dsh-fulltext-search README · 安装：前置：已安装 DSH 与 dsh-better-sidebar（`dsh web` 侧边栏可见）。

> **安装顺序**：先装 dsh-better-sidebar，再装本插件；升级时同样先升级 dsh-better-sidebar。若未检测到 better-sidebar 的 `registerTab` 服务，本插件会打印中文警告并跳过 tab 注册（不会崩溃）。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本仓库路径>

dsh-fulltext-search README · 例如：dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\git\dsh-fulltext-search：```

装完需**重启 DSH**，并**硬刷新浏览器**（Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R）。

可选：安装 [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) 以启用最快的搜索引擎（如 `winget install BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC`、`brew install ripgrep` 或 `apt install ripgrep`）；未安装时自动使用内置 JS 引擎，功能一致。

text:
dsh-fulltext-search README · 安全：- 搜索根**恒为服务端会话记录的工作目录**（`sessions.get(sessionId).header.cwd`），请求体中的 `cwd` 字段一律忽略——伪造的 `sessionId` 无法借任意绝对路径把全文搜索扩大到宿主机其他可读目录。
- 会话不存在 → `404 session-not-found`；会话无工作目录 → `400 no-session-cwd`；两者都在任何搜索执行前被拒绝，不存在 `process.cwd()` 兜底。

dsh-fulltext-search README · 使用：1. 打开侧边栏，点 `+` → 选择「全文搜索」（或直接点击放大镜图标）
2. 输入关键字并回车；可用 `.*`（正则）、`Aa`（区分大小写）、`Ab`（全字匹配）按钮与「智能大小写」开关调整匹配方式
3. 点击结果行 → 文件在编辑器 tab 中打开；点击文件名 → 打开文件

dsh-fulltext-search README · dsh-fulltext-search：A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin that searches file **contents** in the current session working directory from the sidebar file manager ([dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)), returning `file + line number + matching line preview`. Click a result to open the file in the editor.

dsh-fulltext-search README · dsh-fulltext-search：Supports regular expressions, match case, whole-word exact matching, smart case, and include/exclude scope filters. When [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) is installed it is used automatically (the same engine as VS Code search, best performance); otherwise a built-in JS engine is used with identical features.

dsh-fulltext-search README · Installation：Prerequisites: DSH and dsh-better-sidebar installed (the sidebar is visible in `dsh web`).

> **Install order**: install dsh-better-sidebar FIRST, then this plugin; upgrade dsh-better-sidebar first as well. If the better-sidebar `registerTab` service is missing, this plugin logs a Chinese warning and skips tab registration (it never crashes the GUI).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<path-to-this-repo>

dsh-fulltext-search README · e.g. dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\git\dsh-fulltext-search：```

After installing, **restart DSH** and **hard-refresh the browser** (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R).

Optional: install [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) to enable the fastest search engine (`winget install BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC`, `brew install ripgrep`, or `apt install ripgrep`); when absent, the built-in JS engine is used with identical features.

text:
dsh-fulltext-search README · Security：- The search root is **always the server-recorded session working directory** (`sessions.get(sessionId).header.cwd`); a `cwd` field in the request body is always ignored — a forged `sessionId` cannot widen full-text search to other readable host directories via an arbitrary absolute path.
- Unknown sessions → `404 session-not-found`; sessions without a working directory → `400 no-session-cwd`. Both are rejected before any search runs, and there is no `process.cwd()` fallback.

dsh-fulltext-search README · Usage：1. Open the sidebar, click `+` → choose **Full-Text Search** (or click the magnifier icon).
2. Type a keyword and press Enter; use the `.*` (regex), `Aa` (match case), `Ab` (whole word) buttons and the "smart case" toggle to adjust matching.
3. Click a result row → the file opens in the editor tab; click a file name → open the file.
